name: unity-controller
description: Connects to an external Unity Editor. Lists instances, reads local project, scripts, shaders, objects, resources, logs, tests, build and package status, rendering, physics and API metadata. Edits scenes, objects, built-in components, prefabs, data assets, materials, textures, cameras, meshes, animation, VFX, physics, UI, lighting, tags and layers. Supports scene repair, undo/redo, clearing logs, project screenshots and batches of up to 20. See Allowed operations for every tool, action and resource.

settings.title: Unity instance (Name@hash)
settings.description: Use unity_controller_instances to obtain Name@hash. Required for project queries; leave empty only to list instances.
